facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post "Life in Adtech: Creating strategy informed ads" was published on 2022-07-26.
StackAdapt's Creative Strategists build ad creation and support for clients who do not have access to creative resources or an in-house creative team.
facts.quote: My goal as a Creative Strategist is to provide ad creation and support to clients who do not have access to creative resources or a creative team in house.

facts.fact: According to a StackAdapt Creative Strategist, the creative process begins by reviewing the client's advertising plan to see how the creative fits into their funnel and supports overall goals.
facts.quote: I start by reviewing the client’s advertising plan to develop an idea of how the creative I’m working on will fit into their funnel
